correctness.rationale: All augmented simplices are generated by exhaustive disjoint-edge recursion at each of seven widths. All matched cover arrows are reversed and every other Hasse arrow directed downward; exact Kahn sorting processes every simplex, including all 1,222,550 simplices at width eight. For widths 2–7 only critical top cells remain after pairing the empty face; for width 8 exactly 95 dimension-7 cells and one dimension-8 cell remain. Signed pivot elimination from the actual complete matching gives differential entries +1,+1,-1,+1,+1 on five named critical faces; gcd is one. Whitehead/Hurewicz in dimension seven identifies primitive attachment cofiber as 94 seven-spheres. Actual packaged verifier reproduces all values; no infinite conclusion is drawn.
